modelOverview: The Rolex GMT-Master II is the brand's dual-time-zone traveller's watch, tracing its lineage to the 1955 GMT-Master developed for Pan Am pilots. Its defining feature is a 24-hour graduated bidirectional bezel paired with an independent fourth hand, allowing the wearer to read a second and even third time zone at a glance. The modern generation is built around the 40mm Oyster case and the Calibre 3285 movement, with colourways that have earned enthusiast nicknames such as Batman, Pepsi, Sprite and Rootbeer.

126710BLNR.materials: Oystersteel case and bracelet (Jubilee or Oyster)
126710BLNR.bezel: Bidirectional 24-hour Cerachrom insert in blue and black ceramic
126710BLNR.dial: Black with Chromalight luminous markers and Mercedes hands
126710BLNR.description: The 'Batman' (on Oyster) and 'Batgirl' (on Jubilee) reference 126710BLNR pairs an all-Oystersteel case with the two-tone blue-and-black ceramic bezel that gives it its nickname. It runs the Superlative Chronometer Calibre 3285 with a roughly 70-hour power reserve and independent local-hour setting for effortless travel across time zones. Every example is professionally sourced and authenticated.

126720VTNR.materials: Oystersteel case and bracelet (Jubilee or Oyster)
126720VTNR.bezel: Bidirectional 24-hour Cerachrom insert in green and black ceramic
126720VTNR.dial: Black with Chromalight luminous markers, date at 9 o'clock
126720VTNR.description: The 'Sprite' reference 126720VTNR is Rolex's left-handed (destro) GMT-Master II, with the winding crown and date window relocated to the 9 o'clock side for wear on the right wrist. Its exclusive green-and-black Cerachrom bezel, reserved for this model, gives it the nickname. Powered by the Calibre 3285 with a ~70-hour reserve, each piece is sourced and authenticated.

126710BLRO.description: The 'Pepsi' reference 126710BLRO revives the red-and-blue bezel of the original 1955 GMT-Master in modern Cerachrom ceramic on an all-Oystersteel case. It carries the Calibre 3285 with a roughly 70-hour power reserve and Superlative Chronometer certification. Available on both Jubilee and Oyster bracelets, each watch is professionally sourced and authenticated.

126719BLRO.description: The white-gold 'Pepsi' reference 126719BLRO recasts the red-and-blue GMT in solid 18k white gold on a matching Oyster bracelet, offered with either a natural meteorite dial or a sunburst blue dial. It runs the Calibre 3285 with a ~70-hour power reserve. Each example is professionally sourced and authenticated.

variants.White Gold Pepsi – Meteorite Dial: The 126719BLRO with a meteorite dial cut from an iron meteorite, its natural Widmanstätten crystalline pattern making every dial genuinely one-of-a-kind. Set in solid 18k white gold with the red-and-blue Cerachrom Pepsi bezel and gold Chromalight markers.
variants.White Gold Pepsi – Blue Dial: The 126719BLRO with a lacquered sunburst blue dial that echoes the blue of the Pepsi bezel for a monochromatic look. Cased entirely in 18k white gold with gold hour markers, on a white-gold Oyster bracelet.
